headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Sector Tempo Shifts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Weathered Expanse has flared anew, recording eight strategic-base events in the latest two hours and 57 across the day, though casualty and enlistment rates are cooling. Nevish Line likewise quickened, with five recent events, 21 in 24 hours, and accelerating casualty and enlistment rates; its ledger stands divided at five Warden and three Colonial bases. Mooring County remains unsettled at the latest filing, adding two events in two hours and seven in the day, with nine Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base; Warden casualties have accelerated in the latest hour. Palantine Berm shows four events in six hours and 33 in the current daily record, but none in the newest two-hour window. Callahan’s Passage has gone quiet at the immediate edge despite seven events in six hours and 21 in the day. Fisherman’s Row is quieter still, with one event in six hours and 15 in the day. Kuura Strand retains a 21-event daily record, though its recent activity has slackened.
